data.explanation: This is an invoice for the yearly maintenance of your gas boiler, including replacement of an ignition electrode and a call-out fee. You need to pay the total amount by the deadline shown, transferring it to the IBAN given. The letter does not state a Verwendungszweck, but it is good practice to quote the invoice number KD-2026-11873 when paying. If you think the charges are wrong, contact the company directly before the deadline. Keep this invoice, since craftsman labour costs for maintenance work on your home can often be deducted on your tax return.
data.tax_note: Labour costs for craftsman services (Handwerkerleistungen) such as heating maintenance can be claimed under §35a EStG; keep this invoice and the bank transfer receipt as proof.
